$comment: The Scarlet Keys solver database. Connections verbatim from the verified campaign map; scenario/resolution/time data extracted from the campaign guide. Functional game data only.

time_mechanics.travel: 1 time per path used to reach a destination (minimum 1).
time_mechanics.passthrough: You may pass through a node without stopping (still costs 1 per path).
time_mechanics.stop_lockout: Once you stop at a node you cannot stop there again (unless told otherwise).
time_mechanics.resolution_time: Completing a scenario marks the time listed on its resolution.
time_mechanics.side_story_time: Side story costs time = its XP cost only if played; 0 if passing through.
time_mechanics.locked_nodes: A locked node cannot be entered (stopped at OR passed through) until its unlock_condition flag is set in campaign state. This makes the graph dynamic.

$achievements_note: Tokens: in TSK the campaign chaos tokens are 'tablet' and 'elder_thing' (the campaign guide PDF mis-rendered them as bless/curse). `constraint` describes how the solver routes for / detects each achievement; `planning:false` excludes an achievement from single-run planning.

trial_logic.description: Each Coterie member votes yea (dispose of cell), nay (keep cell safe), or abstains/silent. Tally decides the finale branch.

branches.three_silent: Else if 3+ members eerily silent -> Trial 7 (stop tally).
branches.nay_overthrow: Nays win AND La Chica Roja, Ece, Desi all nay -> Trial 3 (overthrow).
branches.nay_join: Nays win AND Thorne, Masai, Claret Knight all nay -> Trial 4 (join).

trust_deception.epilogue: Foundation Trust >= Cell Deception -> Epilogue 4 (permanent position). Otherwise Epilogue 5 (dismantled).
